newsitem.title: SWEDEN: MTG SAYS LITHUANIA'S TELE3 TO BECOME TV3.
newsitem.headline: MTG SAYS LITHUANIA'S TELE3 TO BECOME TV3.

text.p: Modern Times Group (MTG), the media subsidiary of Swedish holding company Kinnevik, said on Friday the Lithuanian TV station Tele-3 would start operating as a TV3 station in June.
"Thereby the station will be able to benefit from the knowledge existing in all TV3 organisations in the Baltics and Scandinavia," MTG said in a statement.
MTG holds an 84 percent stake in Tele-3 and has TV3 operations in five countries in Northern Europe.
The commercial Tele-3 station has been developing strongly this spring and increased its market share to 30 percent from 25 percent, MTG said.
In 1997, the Lithuanian television advertising market is expected to amount to 80 million Swedish crowns, which is a 20 percent increase from the previous year, MTG said.
